Full Body Dumbbell Workout Routine

A comprehensive full-body home workout routine using a pair of dumbbells to target every major muscle group. Ideal for muscle building, toning, and fat loss without complex gym machinery.

20–30 min
Duration
10
Exercises
1 Circuit
Blocks
Intermediate Dumbbells Yoga Mat
0 of 10 done

Exercise Flow

Check off each exercise as you complete sets. Rest timer at the bottom.
01

Bicep Curls

3 sets × 10–12 reps
Biceps
  • Keep elbows tucked close to your torso
  • Bend elbows fully to contract biceps at top range

Why: Isolates and strengthens the bicep muscles.

02

Tricep Extension

3 sets × 10–12 reps
Triceps
  • Keep elbows pointed forward and close to head
  • Extend arms overhead until elbows are straight

Why: Targets the long head of the triceps for upper arm strength.

03

Dumbbell Squats

3 sets × 10–12 reps
QuadsGlutes
  • Rest dumbbells on shoulders or hold at chest level
  • Lower hips deep into squat while keeping chest lifted

Why: Builds quad strength and lower body power.

04

Shoulder Press

3 sets × 10–12 reps
ShouldersTriceps
  • Press dumbbells overhead until arms are fully extended
  • Maintain a stable core without overarching back

Why: Strengthens shoulder deltoids and upper body pressing power.

05

Bent Rows

3 sets × 10–12 reps
BackLatsRear Delts
  • Hinge forward at hips with a flat back
  • Pull dumbbells towards hips squeezing shoulder blades

Why: Targets upper and middle back for posture and strength.

06

Stiff Leg Deadlift

3 sets × 10–12 reps
HamstringsGlutesLower Back
  • Keep legs relatively straight with a slight knee bend
  • Hinge at hips lowering dumbbells along legs until hamstring stretch

Why: Strengthens posterior chain and hamstring flexibility.

07

Floor Press

3 sets × 10–12 reps
ChestTriceps
  • Lie flat on back and align dumbbells with chest
  • Press dumbbells straight up above chest line

Why: Develops chest muscle definition and shoulder stability safely on the floor.

08

Dumbbell Shrugs

3 sets × 12–15 reps
Upper Traps
  • Keep elbows straight and arms by sides
  • Elevate shoulders straight up towards ears and pause

Why: Isolates and builds the upper trapezius muscles.

09

Weighted Glute Bridge

3 sets × 12–15 reps
GlutesHamstrings
  • Rest dumbbell over lower hips/thighs
  • Drive through heels to lift hips upward squeezing glutes

Why: Activates and builds strength in the gluteal muscles.

10

Weighted Situps

3 sets × 10–12 reps
AbsCore
  • Hold dumbbell close to chest or press overhead as you sit up
  • Engage core throughout movement without straining neck

Why: Adds extra resistance to core training for stronger abdominal muscles.

Trainer Tips

  • Choose a dumbbell weight that allows proper form for all exercises.
  • Maintain controlled tempo on both eccentric (lowering) and concentric (raising) phases.
  • Rest 60 to 90 seconds between sets to maximize strength and muscle retention.
